story_type: river canyon hoist after multi-day search
hook: Days of searching ended at the bottom of this canyon.
narration: This man was stranded deep in Oregon's Illinois River Valley, near Greenwall Rapids.
The search for him took days, alongside the Josephine County Sheriff's Office.
In a canyon, the flight mechanic watches straight down and talks the pilot into a steady hover.
The crew lowered a litter, then the rescue basket.
outcome: The North Bend helicopter crew hoisted him out of the river valley.
title: Found in an Oregon river canyon
description:
On Feb. 20, 2026, a Coast Guard helicopter crew from North Bend, Oregon, rescued a stranded man from the Illinois River Valley near Greenwall Rapids after a multi-day search alongside the Josephine County Sheriff's Office.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, Air Station North Bend, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/996824/coast-guard-rescues-stranded-man-illinois-river-valley
